enrichment.description: This workspace's latest enrichment run of the business (BF-027).

hasEmail.description: Whether an email contact is known (the address itself is not listed).

rationale.description: Why the model proposed it (LLM mappings).

personName.description: Only when published by the business itself (data minimization).

expiresInDays.description: Omit for a key that does not expire.

key.description: The secret key. Shown once; store it now — it cannot be retrieved again.

preferenceRank.description: Position in the workspace preference order (0 first).

secretName.description: Vault secret the provider needs, if any.

status.description: ready; not_configured (its secret is missing); disabled (by the workspace); unavailable (feature off).

autoEnrich.description: Enrich businesses this run adds to the workspace (`discovery.business.found`, BF-027).

fieldTier.description: Google field tier for this run (workspace setting by default).

maxResults.description: Stop fetching beyond this many records.

available.description: False when the deployment disabled this feature.

enabled.description: Effective value: the workspace choice (or default) and the deployment switch.

workspaceValue.description: The workspace's own choice, or the default when it never chose.

approximate.description: Boundary derived from points (e.g. Voronoi cells), not surveyed.

survivorId.description: Which of the two businesses survives a merge (default: A).

mine.description: Whether the caller created it (only the creator may change it).

acknowledgement.description: The owner acknowledgement in force (current warning version), if any.

allowed.description: All three gates pass: the scraper may run for this workspace.

deployed.description: FEATURE_MAPS_SCRAPER is on and a scraper URL is configured.

flagEnabled.description: The workspace feature flag `mapsScraper` is on.

website.description: `weak`: has a site that audits rate poorly (slow, outdated, not mobile friendly).

includeDescendants.description: Also match the subcategories (e.g. pizzerias for restaurants).

keywords.description: Terms not covered by a category (e.g. "vegan", "rooftop").

language.description: Language the prompt is written in.

text.description: The location phrase as written in the prompt.

mode.description: `listings`: filter businesses already found; `discover`: find new ones; `both`.

last4.description: Last four characters of the workspace value (long values only).

source.description: Where the value would come from: the workspace vault, the deployment env, or nowhere (null).

message.description: Short provider answer; never contains the secret.
